subject: gdpr-csoai-crosswalk

csoai_axes.A10_privacy: direct alignment — data protection by design (Art25)
csoai_axes.A1_governance: Art24 accountability, Art30 records of processing
csoai_axes.A9_transparency: Art13-14 information obligations, Art22 automated decisions

metrics.ai_intersection: GDPR Art22 (automated decision-making) + EU AI Act Art50 (AI transparency) = dual compliance
metrics.measurement_opportunity: Measure GDPR+AI Act dual compliance for all AI systems processing EU data

honest_sentence: GDPR crosswalk: effective May2018. CSOAI axes: A10→privacy by design, A1→accountability, A22→automated decisions, A8→DPIA/breach notification, A11→security. GDPR Art22 + EU AI Act Art50 = dual compliance. Measure both simultaneously.
